answer: Filling 90 aliases therefore needs 90 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the zephyr record and indexed in the whisper history, the delta audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 6 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
